visualCharacteristics.purpose: tabbed panels with an ARIA tablist (role=tab/tabpanel, aria-selected, arrow/Home/End key navigation); the first tab is active
visualCharacteristics.description: Base: boxed tab buttons on a light background, bordered panel. adventure: tab labels 14px uppercase, 8px 16px padding, no row border; active tab #202020 with white text, inactive transparent with #202020 text, no hover change. Panel paragraphs 18px, line-height 2.5, justified, 13.5px bottom margin; images full panel width; lists without bullets, 12px left padding, 36px line-height.

contentPattern.structure: cell 1 = tab label (plain text), cell 2 = panel rich text (paragraphs, H2/H3, images, lists); a label with no content keeps an empty panel, extra cells merge into the panel, fully empty rows are dropped

usage: Overview / Itinerary / What to Bring panels on adventure detail pages, e.g. https://wknd.site/us/en/adventures/bali-surf-camp.html.
reuseGuidance: Use Tabs (Adventure) for flat text-heavy tabbed content with a dark active tab. Use the plain tabs for boxed panels.
